issues.span: A sprout arises from a seed, and / Just as the seed is known by that very sprout, / By the consciousness arisen from the object of knowledge, / Why is its existence not known?
issues.evidence: The verse is the opponent's objection: bo-kunpal 9-114 opens "ཡང་དེ་དག་འདི་སྙམ་དུ..." and ends "...ཅིས་མི་རྟོགས་ཏེ་རྟོགས་སོ་ཞེ་ན"; bo-shenga 9-114 ends "...ཅིས་མི་རྟོགས་ཞེ་ན། འདི་ནི་དཔེ་དང་འདྲ་བ་མ་ཡིན་ནོ" (the reply comes in 9-115). The translation leaves it unmarked, whereas the parallel objections 9-106 and 9-109 are set in quotation marks, so the reader cannot tell who speaks.
issues.fix: "A sprout arises from a seed, and / Just as the seed is known by that very sprout, / By the consciousness arisen from the object of knowledge, / Why is its existence not known?" (set in quotation marks as the opponent's objection)
